shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/stela with carved relief on its face
low-relief carving covering the front surface
vertically organized composition on a tall standing stone
human figure (drawn beside monument in A; anthropomorphic form of the sculpture in B)
justification: Both depict an upright carved slab with low-relief motifs on its face, but that is largely a shared format rather than shared iconography: A shows a dense double column of repeated square blocks each packed with intricate face-like signs, while B shows a single large anthropomorphic body with a headdress/hair mass, simple eye-like depressions, a plain disc on the chest and broad sparse contours. The rendering conventions differ sharply — A is minute, dense and highly detailed in a strict grid, B is broad, sparse and sculptural with rounded volumes.
